chapters.label: The final
chapters.text: Bilbao, twenty twenty-five: the Europa League final. Manchester United kept hitting long balls at Tottenham. Here is how Spurs captain Cristian Romero handled them: race, and slide!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Romero reads where the ball will drop. He is a step closer than the striker. Now he slides.

chapters.label: Ball first
chapters.text: His boot reaches the ball first, pokes it away. Clean! That night, Romero was named player of the match.

chapters.label: Be smart
chapters.text: Be brave, be smart: slide only when you are sure you can reach the ball first. Too late? Stay on your feet!
